title: What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci U
question: What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci Ulrich? List the schools and the corresponding average writing scores.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(si.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWritingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN scoreInfo si ON s.CDSCode = si.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY s.School
